text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswanan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Air Botswana, identified in a recent private sector report as a candidate for privatisation, is expecting to reduce its 2.1 million pula loss in 1995 to Pula 1.8 million in the curent year, general manager Joshua Galeforolwe says.
- Botswana Telecommunications Corporation plans to start Botswana's first Internet connections to service providers next week.

- Two Zimbabweans, arrested for an alleged attempt to hijack a car, have claimed they were assaulted by arresting officers who kicked them and beat them with sjamboks. The men were subsequently released for lack of evidence. The police have confirmed hey are conducting an investigation into the alleged assaults.
